Co-operative Bank of Kenya is one of the largest sustainable banks in the region. The Covid_19 Pandemic
has presented disruption globally and as Co-operative Bank we have responded strategically to the current
environment.
1. We continue to gain from our institutionalized Transformation seeking efficiency and growth. Key
ongoing Transformation initiatives aimed at a quality loan book are;
• Credit Review Implementation Project “Project Kilele” with McKinsey &Co.
• Decentralization of loan portfolio management enabling Project 3C (Connect, Collect and Cure)
2. Key gains for sustainable performance;
i. Investment in Ecredit;
• Strong penetration; disbursement of Kshs. 4.6B per month
• Good yield of 8% flat.
• Short term tenor of maximum 90 days.
• Consumer based that is on salary checkoff deductions at source.
• Low NPL
